Never locates the removed dsh-client-runtime imports issue or the package.json client.inject entry; the report keeps the old dsh-client-runtime import in its target shape and claims type/inject faces unchanged.

Card IDs are all 'DSH-0.1.2-A1-xx' placeholders (skills/ unreadable), so changes are not tied to DSH-0.1.2-A1-03 or A1-25; projection-vs-immediate split exists but card mapping itself is absent.
